profile.name: Yoctopuce I2C 端口模块
profile.description: 用于驱动和管理 Yoctopuce 的 I2C 硬件端口，可在实验系统中与各类 I2C 传感器、执行器或外围模块进行通信。支持设置总线电压与通信模式、发送和接收 I2C 数据、查询响应，以及在设备上上传和运行任务文件。
profile.description_en: A hardware I2C interface from Yoctopuce used to communicate with I2C sensors, actuators, and peripheral modules in lab setups. It supports configuring bus voltage and communication mode, sending and receiving I2C data, performing query-response transactions, and uploading or running job files on the device.

registry.description: The YI2cPort classe allows you to fully drive a Yoctopuce I2C port
